parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:

If this parameter is not set or is set to a value less than 10, the default value is 10.
If this parameter is set to a value greater than 100, the default value is 100

默认值：

当不设置值或设置的值小于10时，默认值为10。
当设置的值大于100时，默认值为100

parameters.help_en:
The list of private IP addresses of instances in the classic network. This parameter takes effect when InstanceNetworkType is set to classic. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

The classic network feature has been discontinued. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html
parameters.help_zh:
经典网络类型实例的内网IP列表。当InstanceNetworkType=classic时生效，取值可以由多个IP组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个IP，IP之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。 

经典网络功能已下线，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html
parameters.name: inner_ip_addresses

parameters.help_en: The private IP addresses of instances in a VPC network type. This parameter takes effect when InstanceNetworkType is set to vpc. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IP addresses. Separate the IP addresses with commas (,)

parameters.help_en: The public IP addresses of the instances. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IP addresses. Separate the IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例的公网IP列表。取值可以由多个IP组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个IP，IP之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
parameters.name: public_ip_addresses

parameters.help_en: The elastic IP addresses (EIPs) of the instances. This parameter takes effect when InstanceNetworkType is set to vpc. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IP addresses. Separate the IP addresses with commas (,)

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.
PrePaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
实例的计费方式。取值范围： 
         
PostPaid：按量付费。 
PrePaid：包年包月
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for public bandwidth. Valid values:

PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth.
PayByTraffic: pay-by-traffic.

In pay-by-traffic mode, the peak inbound and outbound bandwidths are both bandwidth upper limits and are not guaranteed. When resource contention occurs, the peak bandwidth may be throttled. If your business requires guaranteed bandwidth, use the pay-by-bandwidth mode
parameters.help_zh:
公网带宽计费方式。取值范围：

PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽计费。
PayByTraffic：按使用流量计费。

按使用流量计费模式下的出入带宽峰值都是带宽上限，不作为业务承诺指标。当出现资源争抢时，带宽峰值可能会受到限制。如果您的业务需要有带宽的保障，请使用按固定带宽计费模式
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance. Fuzzy search with the wildcard * is supported
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称，支持使用通配符*进行模糊搜索。

parameters.help_en: The image ID
parameters.help_zh: 镜像ID

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:

Pending: being created.
Running: running.
Starting: being started.
Stopping: being stopped.
Stopped: stopped

实例状态。取值范围： 

Pending：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Starting：启动中。
Stopping：停止中。
Stopped：已停止

parameters.help_en:
The reason why the resource is locked. Valid values:

financial: The resource is locked due to overdue payment.

security: The resource is locked for security reasons.

Recycling: The spot instance is locked and pending release.

dedicatedhostfinancial: The ECS instance is locked because the dedicated host has an overdue payment.

refunded: The resource is locked due to a refund
parameters.help_zh:
资源被锁定的原因。取值范围：

financial：因欠费被锁定。

security：因安全原因被锁定。

Recycling：抢占式实例的待释放锁定状态。

dedicatedhostfinancial：因为专有宿主机欠费导致ECS实例被锁定。

refunded：因退款被锁定
parameters.name: lock_reason

parameters.help_en: The key of filter 1 used to query resources. Set the value to `CreationStartTime`. When both `Filter.1.Key` and `Filter.1.Value` are specified, you can query resources that were created after the specified point in time
parameters.help_zh: 查询资源时的筛选键，取值必须为`CreationStartTime`。同时设置`Filter.1.Key`和`Filter.1.Value`可以查询在指定时间点后创建的资源信息
parameters.name: filter_1_key

parameters.help_en: The key of filter 2 used to query resources. Set the value to `CreationEndTime`. When both `Filter.2.Key` and `Filter.2.Value` are specified, you can query resources that were created before the specified point in time

parameters.name: filter_3_key

parameters.help_en: The key of filter 4 used to query resources. Set the value to `ExpiredEndTime`. When both `Filter.4.Key` and `Filter.4.Value` are specified, you can query resources that expire before the specified point in time
parameters.help_zh: 查询资源时的筛选键，取值必须为`ExpiredEndTime`。同时设置`Filter.4.Key`和`Filter.4.Value`可以查询在指定时间点前到期的资源信息

parameters.help_en: The value of filter 1 used to query resources. When you specify this parameter, you must also specify `Filter.1.Key`. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format in UTC+0

v1_parameters.help_en:
The billing method for public bandwidth. Valid values:

PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth.
PayByTraffic: pay-by-traffic.

In pay-by-traffic mode, the peak inbound and outbound bandwidths are both bandwidth upper limits and are not guaranteed. When resource contention occurs, the peak bandwidth may be throttled. If your business requires guaranteed bandwidth, use the pay-by-bandwidth mode
v1_parameters.help_zh:
公网带宽计费方式。取值范围：

PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽计费。
PayByTraffic：按使用流量计费。

按使用流量计费模式下的出入带宽峰值都是带宽上限，不作为业务承诺指标。当出现资源争抢时，带宽峰值可能会受到限制。如果您的业务需要有带宽的保障，请使用按固定带宽计费模式
